answer.book: Lentulus's posthumous Latin political-historical miscellany Florum hortuli historico-politici (1651): a single work in six Coronae, each a numbered series of Flores, every Flos a historical exemplum under a motto heading, framed by a dedication, an oeconomia, an index of Coronae and a closing index rerum memorabilium.
